title: chore: update app metrics 2026-10-01
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily automated update of app request and repository metrics

gist.headline: The garden keeps count
gist.blurb: The daily app-metrics ledger gets its October 1 entry. Even code gardens have paperwork.
gist.summary: The automated October 1, 2026 update refreshes app request and repository metrics in operations/app-management/app.json, keeping the app-management record current.
gist.impact: The app-management record gains an October 1 snapshot of request and repository metrics; this does not change app behavior.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the automated app-metrics update as a dated ledger beside a retro terminal, with small charts shaped like growing plants. Polli wears tiny accountant glasses and checks the October 1 entry; a friendly monitor robot holds the ledger.
